question: Which entity is the direct accounting consolidation parent of the entity with LEI 5493002WI30SR6SIUH74? Give its legal name.
sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>
PREFIX lei: <https://www.gleif.org/data/lei/>

SELECT ?parentName
WHERE {
  lei:5493002WI30SR6SIUH74 kgx:hasDirectConsolidationParent ?p .
  ?p gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?parentName .
}
LIMIT 1

question: Which entity manages the fund whose legal name is 'VDDKO - MASTERFONDS'? Give the manager's legal name.
sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>

SELECT ?managerName
WHERE {
  ?fund gleif-L1:hasLegalName "VDDKO - MASTERFONDS" .
  ?fund kgx:hasFundManager ?manager .
  ?manager gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?managerName .
}

question: List the legal names of all consolidation ancestors of the entity with LEI 5493002WI30SR6SIUH74, following direct consolidation parents transitively.
sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>
PREFIX lei: <https://www.gleif.org/data/lei/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?ancestorName
WHERE {
  lei:5493002WI30SR6SIUH74 (kgx:hasDirectConsolidationParent)+ ?ancestor .
  ?ancestor gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?ancestorName .
}

question: For the sub-fund named 'Euro Income Fixed Maturity Bond Fund 2030', which entity manages its umbrella fund? Give that manager's legal name.
sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?managerName
WHERE {
  ?subfund gleif-L1:hasLegalName "Euro Income Fixed Maturity Bond Fund 2030" .
  ?subfund kgx:hasUmbrellaFund ?umbrella .
  ?umbrella kgx:hasFundManager ?manager .
  ?manager gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?managerName .
}
